scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('./lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --build ../../configs/ts/references/tsconfig.playwright.json --force && yarn playwright install chromium
scripts.build:runtime: cd ../.. && yarn run build:ext-host && yarn run build:worker-host
scripts.ui-tests: yarn run build:runtime && yarn run build && playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.config.ts
scripts.ui-tests-ci: yarn run build:runtime && yarn run build && playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.ci.config.ts
scripts.ui-tests-concurrent-smoke: yarn run build:runtime && yarn run build && yarn run ui-tests-concurrent-smoke:run
scripts.ui-tests-headful: yarn run build:runtime && yarn run build && playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.headful.config.ts
scripts.ui-tests-report: yarn run build ui-tests-report-generate && allure open allure-results/allure-report
